name: Source Control
description: CRITICAL RULE: Do NOT use `http_fetch` to read files from GitHub URLs. `http_fetch` returns raw HTML, not the file content, and it does not create a local copy you can edit. Do NOT use `bash` to edit files either — on Windows, `bash` cannot run `mkdir -p`, `&&`, or `touch`, and it cannot see files that are not in the current working directory. The ONLY way to edit a file is: create_workspace → str_replace_editor → request_approval → push_branch. Unified interface for interacting with Git repositories. WORKFLOW: (1) Optional discovery: list_providers, list_repositories, get_repository, list_branches. (2) create_workspace(repository_id='owner/repo') → returns workspace_id and workspace_path. You MUST call this BEFORE any str_replace_editor call. (3) Edit files inside workspace_path with the file-edit tool. (4) request_approval(workspace_id=..., operation='push_branch', target_branch='<feature-branch>') → returns operation_id + approval_id. STOP HERE and include BOTH IDs in your final message; the user must approve in the UI. (5) In a subsequent turn, if you do not remember the IDs: call get_operation(operation_id) to verify the current status, or list_operations(status='approved') to find the pending approvals. Then push_branch(operation_id=..., approval_id=...). (6) Then request_approval(workspace_id=..., operation='create_change_request', source_branch='<the branch you pushed>', target_branch='main') → returns NEW operation_id + approval_id. STOP HERE and include both IDs in your final message; the user must approve again. (7) In a subsequent turn: create_change_request(operation_id=..., approval_id=..., title=...). AUTH AND RETRY POLICY (MANDATORY): If any source_control action returns AUTH_REQUIRED, PERMISSION_DENIED, or CONFLICT, you MUST stop immediately and use ask_human exactly ONCE to tell the user what happened. Do NOT retry the same action. Do NOT try a different action to work around it. Do NOT ask for a personal access token — PELDRUN uses OAuth. Example ask_human message: 'The GitHub token has expired (AUTH_REQUIRED). Please go to the Integrations & Providers page, click Disconnect on GitHub, then click Connect to obtain a fresh token. Then tell me to continue.' After the user responds, wait for their instruction before retrying. IMPORTANT: A push approval cannot be reused to open a PR — each side effect needs its own approval. get_operation and list_operations are read-only: they never consume a ticket or change the status. Do NOT use http_fetch or bash for Git operations. Do NOT push or open PRs without a valid approval_id.
short_description: Unified Git interface with mandatory approval gates for pushes and change requests.
store_description: Unified source-control interface for Git repositories across GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket. Provides discovery, workspace creation, diff inspection, pre-registered checks, and an approval-gated workflow that requires explicit user consent before any remote side effect (push_branch or create_change_request) is executed. Uses OAuth-based authentication and enforces a one-ticket-per-side-effect policy.

ar.short_description: Unified Git interface with mandatory approval gates for pushes and change requests.

usage_notes: Follow the documented workflow: create_workspace before any file edit, request_approval before each remote side effect, and never reuse an approval ticket across different operations. On AUTH_REQUIRED / PERMISSION_DENIED / CONFLICT, stop immediately and call ask_human exactly once.

action.description: The source-control action to execute. See the tool description for the full workflow.

params.description: Optional structured parameter bag. Same keys as the top-level parameters; nested values override top-level ones.

repository_id.description: Stable provider repository identifier (e.g., 'owner/repo'). Required for 'create_workspace', 'get_repository', 'list_branches', and 'read_file'.

account_id.description: Optional stable account ID. When omitted, the first stored account for the provider is used.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to read from. Used by 'read_file'.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ID returned by 'create_workspace'. Required for 'create_branch', 'inspect_diff', 'run_checks', and for 'request_approval' when creating a new operation.

branch_name.description: Branch name. Required for 'create_branch'. Optional for 'create_workspace' (defaults to the repository's default branch).

from_sha.description: Optional starting commit SHA for 'create_branch'. Defaults to the workspace's current HEAD.

base_sha.description: Optional base commit SHA. Used by 'inspect_diff' and 'create_workspace' to diff against (or check out) a specific commit.

include_patch.description: When true (default), include per-file diff text in 'inspect_diff' output.

checks.description: Names of pre-registered checks to run. Used by 'run_checks'.

fail_fast.description: When true (default), stop after the first failing check. Used by 'run_checks'.

operation_id.description: Operation ID returned by a previous 'request_approval' call. Required for 'push_branch', 'create_change_request', and 'get_operation'. For 'request_approval': pass this INSTEAD of workspace_id only when re-issuing a ticket for the EXISTING operation; the diff is NOT recomputed in that case, so pass workspace_id + target_branch if files changed since the last approval.

operation.description: The remote side effect the approval covers. 'push_branch' for the first approval (writes to the remote branch). 'create_change_request' for the second, separate approval that opens the PR/MR.

target_branch.description: REQUIRED when creating a new operation via 'request_approval' (workspace_id without operation_id). For 'push_branch': the remote branch the push writes to (typically a feature branch, e.g. 'feature/x'). For 'create_change_request': the PR base branch (e.g. 'main'). MUST differ from source_branch when operation='create_change_request'.

source_branch.description: Optional. The local branch the change lives on. Defaults to the workspace's current branch. For 'create_change_request', this is the branch that was pushed and MUST differ from target_branch.

approval_id.description: Approval ticket ID returned by 'request_approval' and granted by the user in the UI. Required for 'push_branch' and 'create_change_request'.

local_branch.description: Optional override for the local branch to push. Defaults to the operation's source_branch.

title.description: Change-request title. Required for 'create_change_request'. The user reviewed this title.

body.description: Change-request description (Markdown supported). Optional. Used by 'create_change_request'.

draft.description: When true (default), create the change request as a draft. Used by 'create_change_request'.

include_events.description: When true (default), include the event history in 'get_operation' results. Set to false to keep the response compact.

limit.description: Maximum number of operations returned by 'list_operations' (1-100, default 20).

status.description: Optional status filter for 'list_operations' (e.g. 'review_required', 'approved', 'pushed'). Has no effect on other actions. NOTE: distinct from the 'inspect_diff' alias, which normalizes the ACTION value, not this parameter name.

kind.description: Optional kind filter for 'list_operations' (e.g. 'push_branch', 'create_change_request'). Has no effect on other actions.
